candidates.change_summary: Remove the line that sets acc.unlockTime to make it always default to 0, changing Put's behavior on unlockTime.
Change the unlockTime assignment to use only block.timestamp, ignoring the parameter, making the unlock time always current block time.
Change unlockTime to never be set, by assigning 0 (constant), making funds always immediately available.
Delete the balance update, so Put only sets unlockTime without increasing balance, observable by a later Collect.
Delete the locking mechanism in the modifier completely, making the function non-reentrant guard ineffective and changing reentrancy behavior visible in Put's state updates.
Change the modifier to always revert by requiring false, preventing Put from ever succeeding.
Delete the require check for locked_ so the modifier always executes without guarding, allowing reentrant calls that can corrupt Put.
Remove the condition block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime from the if statement, allowing collection regardless of unlock time.
Remove the locked_ = false assignment from the modifier, leaving the contract permanently locked after first use.
Remove the require(!locked_) check, disabling the reentrancy guard entirely.
Delete the entire if block body's inner success check, so acc.balance is never reduced on successful call.
Replace acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am) with acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, _am), increasing balance instead of decreasing.
Move the balance decrement outside the call success check, so balance is reduced even if the ETH transfer fails.
